requirements.title: Articles of Organization — Wyoming LLC Formation
requirements.description: File Articles of Organization with the Wyoming Secretary of State to form the LLC. The LLC name must include 'Limited Liability Company' or an approved abbreviation (LLC, L.L.C., LC, Ltd. Liability Co.). An email address is required under W.S. 17-28-104(e). A name availability search must be conducted before filing. Entities whose names begin with 'A' must file by paper for manual review. Online filing available at wyobiz.wyo.gov; paper filing by mail also accepted.

The agent may be an individual Wyoming resident (at least 18, with a physical Wyoming address that is not a PO box, drop box, mail forwarding service, or UPS store) or a business entity authorized to transact business in Wyoming. Failure to maintain a registered agent results in dissolution or revocation. The registered agent must keep Key Individual information and a Communications Contact on site at the Wyoming address.

requirements.title: Wyoming Annual Report and License Tax
requirements.description: Wyoming LLCs must file an annual report and pay an annual license tax. The fee is $60 or two-tenths of one mill on the dollar ($.0002), whichever is greater, based on company assets located and employed in Wyoming. For an online consulting business with minimal Wyoming-located assets (e.g., under $300,000), the minimum $60 fee applies. The annual report is due on the first day of the anniversary month of formation each year. Entities not paid within 60 days of the due date are subject to dissolution. The license tax worksheet is not a public record.

requirements.description: Delaware does not impose a state or local sales tax but imposes a gross receipts tax on providers of services in the state. The gross receipts tax applies to total revenues from services rendered in Delaware, with no deductions for cost of goods, labor, interest, or other expenses. Each amount and annual recurrence has a matched official citation. Annual charges in Delaware, United States are not sufficiently verified and could change the choice. This supports a provisional first place to investigate. Additional unknown or conditional fees, asset-based charges, local rules and operating in another jurisdiction could change the choice; total cost and fastest/easiest approval have not been established.
tradeoffs: Wyoming, United States: 5 required items; USD 100 verified initial fee lower bound; 5 unknown initial charges; 2 conditional requirements; USD 60 known annual government charge floor; ongoing obligations: Wyoming Annual Report and License Tax, Wyoming Annual Report — Recurring Filing; overall approval time unknown.

Delaware, United States: 6 required items; USD 110 verified initial fee lower bound; 0 unknown initial charges; 4 conditional requirements; ongoing obligations: Delaware Annual LLC Tax — Division of Corporations, Delaware Annual LLC Tax — Recurring Annual Obligation; overall approval time unknown.

California, United States: 7 required items; USD 90 verified initial fee lower bound; 2 unknown initial charges; 2 conditional requirements; USD 800 known annual government charge floor; ongoing obligations: California Statement of Information (Form LLC-12) — Initial and Biennial, California Annual LLC Tax — $800 (Franchise Tax Board), California Biennial Statement of Information — Recurring Filing; overall approval time unknown.
recommendation.method: Compare known unconditional annual government charge floors in a shared currency for at least two places with evidence. Explicitly flag missing places. Numbers and annual recurrence must be quoted and independently matched. This limited ranking is provisional, without converting recurring periods or inferring total cost.
